why: A citation that does not resolve asserts a provenance that is not there, which is strictly worse than claiming none — `dangling-edge`'s own argument carried across the boundary. A server backing this capability has at least one dependency, so it can tell a package it does not carry from having no packages at all, and the message names the repair: declare it and install it. Note that only ONE finding fires: with no package installed there is no text to have drifted, and `external-citation-span-drift` must not also report.

call.span: the slowly varying component sustained by groundwater discharge
